name: workflow-automation-manager
description: Electron desktop app for authorized internal browser automation workflows.
author: Internal Automation Lab <automation-lab@example.invalid>

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.electron:pack:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --linux dir --publish never
scripts.electron:pack:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb tar.gz --publish never
scripts.electron:pack:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis zip --publish never
scripts.electron:pack:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: npm run build:electron && playwright test tests/e2e/electron-isolation.e2e.ts tests/e2e/core-execution.e2e.ts tests/e2e/workflow-user-journeys.e2e.ts tests/e2e/coverage-matrix.e2e.ts tests/e2e/browser-recorder.e2e.ts
scripts.test:e2e:visible: npm run build:electron && E2E_VISIBLE_BROWSER=1 playwright test --headed tests/e2e/browser-context-storage.e2e.ts tests/e2e/capture-network.e2e.ts tests/e2e/core-execution.e2e.ts tests/e2e/extended-form-actions.e2e.ts tests/e2e/human-behavior.e2e.ts tests/e2e/keyboard-dialog.e2e.ts tests/e2e/navigation-actions.e2e.ts tests/e2e/pointer-actions.e2e.ts tests/e2e/wait-assertion-actions.e2e.ts
scripts.test:e2e:flake: npm run build:electron && playwright test tests/e2e/pointer-actions.e2e.ts tests/e2e/human-behavior.e2e.ts tests/e2e/core-execution.e2e.ts tests/e2e/extended-form-actions.e2e.ts tests/e2e/keyboard-dialog.e2e.ts --repeat-each=5
scripts.test:e2e:real-web: npm run build:electron && E2E_REAL_WEB=1 playwright test tests/e2e/real-world-web.e2e.ts
